description: Checkout rejects reasonable input (for example a phone number without the exact +91 format).
detection: Rule B10 (Checkout validation failure) on the request log; evidence below.

replays.verdict_explanation: Reproduced B10 (Checkout rejects a plain 10-digit phone number): checkout rejected a plain 10-digit phone (422 PHONE_FORMAT); only '+91 XXXXX XXXXX' passes (step 16).

recommendation.title: Checkout validation failure: Relax and normalise validation (accept +91 variants) and return clear error messages.
recommendation.body: Relax and normalise validation (accept +91 variants) and return clear error messages.
recommendation.why_it_helps: Checkout rejects reasonable input (for example a phone number without the exact +91 format).
recommendation.how_to_verify: Checkout 422 PHONE_FORMAT count falls; checkout submit conversion rises.
recommendation.verify_metric: Agent sessions ending with B10 per day
recommendation.llm_explanation: Blocker B10 caused checkout validation failures in 12% of failed agent sessions, as indicated by evidence from 225 sessions. Fixing this issue will improve the checkout process, allowing AI shopping agents to complete transactions successfully and enhance overall customer satisfaction.
